title: Climate Policies, Labor Markets, and Macroeconomic Outcomes in Emerging Economies
abstract: We study the labor market and macroeconomic effects of introducing a carbon tax in the energy sector in emerging economies (EMEs) by building a framework with equilibrium unemployment and firm entry that incorporates key elements of the distinct employment and firm structure of EMEs. Our model endogenizes the adoption of green energy-production technologies--a core element of policy discussions regarding the transition to a low-carbon economy. Calibrating the model to EME data, we show that a carbon tax fosters greater green technology adoption and increases the share of green energy produced. However, the tax leads to higher energy prices, which reduce salaried firm creation and formal employment and increase self-employment, labor participation, and unemployment. As a result, the tax generates output and welfare losses. Green technology adoption plays a key role in limiting the quantitative magnitude of these losses, while the response of self-employment is crucial to explaining the adverse labor market and macroeconomic effects of the policy. Given this finding, we show that a carbon tax coupled with a plausible reduction in the cost of becoming a formal firm can offset the adverse effects of the tax and generate a transition to a lower-carbon economy with minimal economic costs. Finally, we show that lowering green-technology adoption costs or the cost of green-energy production inputs--two alternative climate policies--reduces emissions while limiting the output and welfare costs compared to a carbon tax.
abstract_zh: 我们通过构建一个包含均衡失业与企业进入的框架，研究在新兴经济体（EMEs）能源部门征收碳税对劳动力市场和宏观经济的影响，该框架纳入了新兴经济体特有的就业与企业结构的关键要素。我们的模型将绿色能源生产技术的采用内生化，而这正是关于向低碳经济转型的政策讨论中的核心要素。以新兴经济体数据对模型进行校准后，我们发现碳税会促进绿色技术的采用，并提高绿色能源的发电份额。然而，该税收会推高能源价格，从而减少受薪企业的设立和正规就业，并增加自营就业、劳动参与率和失业率。因此，碳税会带来产出和福利损失。绿色技术的采用在限制这些损失的定量规模方面发挥着关键作用，而自营就业的反应则对于解释该政策对劳动力市场和宏观经济的不利影响至关重要。鉴于这一发现，我们表明，若将碳税与合理程度的降低成为正规企业的成本相结合，便可抵消碳税的不利影响，并以最小的经济成本实现向低碳经济的过渡。最后，我们表明，与碳税相比，降低绿色技术采用成本或绿色能源生产投入成本这两种替代性气候政策，能够减少排放，同时限制产出和福利损失。

title: Fintech Entry, Firm Financial Inclusion, and Macroeconomic Dynamics in Emerging Economies
Firm Structure, Labor Markets, and the Green Energy Transition in Low Income Economies
abstract: Zambia, an economy heavily reliant on hydropower, has faced sustained disruptions to electricity generation amid increasingly frequent and severe droughts. These drought-related disruptions have caused large GDP losses and tilted electricity generation towards polluting sources, putting the green transition at risk. Current policy proposals aim to dramatically expand the share of electricity from solar. We study the impact of the green transition amid disruptions to hydropower electricity generation on firm structure, labour, and macroeconomic outcomes in Zambia. We build a macro model with urban salaried firms and self-employed firms, rural self-employed firms, endogenous electricity adoption by firms, and an electricity sector with endogenous production categories. Electricity producers can choose one of three production technologies meant to represent coal, hydro, and solar, and that differ in their carbon-emissions generation, cost structure, and productivity. Calibrating the model to replicate the most recent GDP losses stemming from drought-driven hydropower disruptions in Zambia, we find that subsidizing the adoption of solar electricity to meet the country’s target for solar-electricity shares in 2030 can significantly offset the GDP damages and limit the rise in self-employment due to exogenous disruptions to hydro production. However, these subsidies alone lead to a sharp increase in emissions as greater solar adoption cannot fully offset the decline in hydro. Combining a policy-driven expansion in solar adoption with policies that reduce the incentive to adopt polluting sources of electricity, such as carbon taxes, can deliver non-trivial GDP gains and an expansion in solar without leading to an increase in carbon emissions.
abstract_zh: 赞比亚是一个严重依赖水电的经济体，在日益频繁和严重的干旱背景下，其发电持续受到干扰。与干旱相关的这些中断已造成巨额GDP损失，并使发电偏向污染性能源，从而使绿色转型面临风险。当前的政策提案旨在大幅扩大太阳能发电的份额。我们研究在水电发电受到干扰的情况下，绿色转型对赞比亚企业结构、劳动力和宏观经济结果的影响。我们构建了一个宏观模型，其中包括城市受薪企业和自营企业、农村自营企业、企业内生的电力采用，以及具有内生生产类别的电力部门。电力生产者可以选择三种生产技术，分别代表煤炭、水电和太阳能，它们在碳排放、成本结构和生产率方面各不相同。通过将模型校准为复现赞比亚由干旱引发的水电中断所造成的最近GDP损失，我们发现，补贴太阳能电力的采用，以实现该国2030年太阳能电力份额目标，可以显著抵消GDP损失，并限制外生水电生产中断所导致的自营就业增长。然而，仅靠这些补贴会导致排放急剧上升，因为太阳能采用的增加无法完全抵消水电的减少。将政策驱动的太阳能采用扩张，与减少采用污染性电力来源的激励的政策（例如碳税）相结合，可以带来可观的GDP增长和太阳能扩张，且不会导致碳排放增加。

title: Uncertainty Shocks and Labor Market Dynamics in Emerging Economies
Unequal Electricity Access and the Distributional Consequences of the Green Energy Transition in Sub-Saharan Africa
Who Bears the Burden of Climate Policies? Labor Income Heterogeneity and the Distributional Effects of Carbon Taxation in Emerging Economies
abstract: How does household heterogeneity in labor income sources shape the distributional effects of carbon taxation in emerging economies (EMEs)? Using household-level data for Mexico and Brazil, we document the distribution of households by their main labor-income source, including the prevalence of self-employed-only and hybrid (salaried and self-employed) households, and estimate household-level transitions between household categories. We build a tractable macro model with salaried firms, self-employment, endogenous polluting-green energy production, and heterogeneous households whose transitions between categories are endogenous. Calibrating the model to Mexico, we study a carbon tax under two revenue-recycling schemes: lump-sum transfers to households and subsidies to green-technology adoption. The tax raises energy prices, lowers aggregate consumption and output, and shifts employment from salaried to self-employed firms. Employer households bear the largest consumption and welfare losses, followed by salaried-only households; hybrid households fare similarly to salaried-only households, while self-employed-only households are least affected. A green-subsidy scheme delivers a more uniform response across household categories than a lump-sum-transfer scheme, while also limiting the tax's adverse macroeconomic effects. Abstracting from endogenous household transitions significantly changes the quantitative distributional impact of the tax, especially among self-employed-only and hybrid households. Our results underscore the importance of endogenous household transitions for quantifying the distributional effects of carbon taxation in EMEs.
abstract_zh: 家庭在劳动收入来源上的异质性，如何塑造新兴经济体碳税的分配效应？利用墨西哥和巴西的家庭层面数据，我们记录了家庭按主要劳动收入来源的分布情况，包括仅自营家庭和混合型（受薪与自营）家庭的普遍程度，并估计了家庭在各类别之间的转移。我们构建了一个可处理的宏观模型，其中包括受薪企业、自营就业、内生的污染与绿色能源生产，以及类别之间转移内生化的异质性家庭。以墨西哥为校准对象，我们研究了两种收入返还方案下的碳税：对家庭的一次性转移支付，以及对绿色技术采用的补贴。税收推高能源价格，降低总消费和产出，并使就业从受薪企业转向自营企业。雇主家庭承受的消费和福利损失最大，其次是仅受薪家庭；混合型家庭的情况与仅受薪家庭相近，而仅自营家庭受影响最小。与一次性转移方案相比，绿色补贴方案对各家庭类别的影响更为均匀，同时也更能减轻税收的不利宏观经济效应。忽略内生的家庭转移会显著改变税收的定量分配影响，对仅自营家庭和混合型家庭尤为明显。我们的结果强调了内生的家庭转移对于量化新兴经济体碳税分配效应的重要性。

title: Overcoming Five Key Challenges to Make the Energy Transition a Just Labor Transition
abstract: Shifting rapidly to a low-emissions global economy could severely disrupt workers’ livelihoods and their communities, exacerbating inequalities and perpetuating injustice. In a Just Labor Transition, strategic policies prepare workers for new jobs, enable inclusive decision-making with meaningful participation of workers and their representatives (including labor unions and other collective organizations), and secure social license for change.
abstract_zh: 迅速转向低排放的全球经济，可能严重扰乱工人的生计及其社区，加剧不平等并延续不公。在“公正劳动力转型”中，战略性政策应使工人为新工作做好准备，促成包容性决策，让工人及其代表（包括工会和其他集体组织）有意义地参与其中，并确保转型获得社会许可。

title: Temporary Layoffs, Firm Entry and Exit Dynamics, and Aggregate Fluctuations
Labor Market and Macroeconomic Dynamics in Latin America Amid COVID: The Role of Digital Adoption Policies
Carbon Policy, the Green Transition, and Inflation Dynamics
abstract: We study the effects of carbon taxes on inflation dynamics. We focus on two channels through which carbon taxation can shape inflation: the economy's market structure and green technology adoption. First, using data from the European Union, we show that carbon taxes can affect the share of green energy and new firm creation. Then, we build a New Keynesian model with environmental externalities and an energy sector, endogenous firm entry in the goods sector, and an endogenous polluting-green production structure in both the goods and the energy sectors. Calibrating the model using European data, we show that for the same quantitative reduction in emissions, taxing emissions from the goods sector has very different implications for inflation dynamics compared to taxing emissions from the energy sector. Further model analysis reveals that both endogenous firm entry and producers' ability to adopt green technologies offset the deflationary pressures that are otherwise generated by carbon taxation, and contribute to the divergence in inflation dynamics between goods-based and energybased carbon taxes. Importantly, our quantitative analysis shows that taxing emissions in the two sectors jointly generates little inflation along the transition path to a lower-emissions environment, whereas taxing emissions in the goods sector without taxing energy-related emissions generates a nontrivial increase in inflation. More broadly, our work highlights the importance of market structure and technology adoption for understanding the quantitative impact of carbon taxes on inflation along the transition to a lower-carbon environment, and illustrates how for the same reduction in emissions, sectoral carbon taxes can have heterogeneous effects on inflation.
abstract_zh: 我们研究碳税对通胀动态的影响。我们聚焦于碳税影响通胀的两条渠道：经济的市场结构和绿色技术的采用。首先，利用欧盟数据，我们表明碳税可以影响绿色能源的份额以及新企业的设立。随后，我们构建了一个新凯恩斯主义模型，其中包含环境外部性和能源部门、商品部门内生的企业进入，以及在商品部门和能源部门中内生的污染与绿色生产结构。以欧洲数据校准该模型后，我们表明，在实现相同定量减排的情况下，对商品部门排放征税与对能源部门排放征税，对通胀动态的影响截然不同。进一步的模型分析显示，内生的企业进入和生产者采用绿色技术的能力，都会抵消碳税原本产生的通缩压力，并促成商品型碳税与能源型碳税之间通胀动态的分化。重要的是，我们的定量分析表明，在两个部门共同征税，在迈向低排放环境的转型路径上几乎不会产生通胀；而仅对商品部门排放征税、不对能源相关排放征税，则会带来显著的通胀上升。更广泛地说，我们的研究强调了市场结构和技术采用对于理解碳税在迈向低碳环境过程中对通胀定量影响的重要性，并说明了对于相同的减排幅度，分部门的碳税可能对通胀产生异质性影响。

title: Firm Creation, Entry Costs, and House-Price Volatility
The Macroeconomic Effects of a Carbon Tax to Meet the U.S. Paris Agreement Target: The Role of Firm Creation and Technology Adoption
abstract: We analyze the quantitative labor market and aggregate effects of a carbon tax in a framework with pollution externalities and equilibrium unemployment. Our model incorporates endogenous labor force participation and two margins of adjustment influenced by carbon taxes: (1) firm creation and (2) green production-technology adoption.A carbon-tax policy that reduces carbon emissions by 35 percent -roughly the emissions reductions that will be required under the Biden Administration's new commitment under the Paris Agreement -and transfers the tax revenue to households generates mild positive long-run effects on consumption and output; a marginal increase in the unemployment and labor force participation rates; and an expansion in the number and fraction of firms that use green technologies. In the short term, the adjustment to higher carbon taxes is accompanied by gradual gains in output and consumption and a negligible expansion in unemployment. Critically, abstracting from endogenous firm entry and greentechnology adoption implies that the same policy has substantial adverse short-and long-term effects on labor income, consumption, and output. Our findings highlight the importance of these margins for a comprehensive assessment of the labor market and aggregate effects of carbon taxes.
abstract_zh: 我们在一个包含污染外部性和均衡失业的框架下，分析碳税对劳动力市场和总量经济的定量影响。我们的模型纳入了内生的劳动参与，以及受碳税影响的两个调整渠道：（1）企业设立，以及（2）绿色生产技术的采用。一项使碳排放减少35%（大致相当于拜登政府在《巴黎协定》下的新承诺所要求的减排幅度）并将税收收入返还家庭的碳税政策，会带来温和的正向长期效应：消费和产出小幅上升；失业率和劳动参与率边际上升；使用绿色技术的企业数量和比例扩大。在短期内，随着碳税提高，产出和消费逐步增长，失业率的扩大则可以忽略不计。关键在于，若忽略内生的企业进入和绿色技术采用，同一政策将对劳动收入、消费和产出产生显著的短期和长期不利影响。我们的研究结果表明，这些调整渠道对于全面评估碳税的劳动力市场和总量经济效应至关重要。
